integrity: Analytic parameter-domain proof, exact resultant and Sturm signs, rational witness, reproducible independent symbolic and numerical checks. No independent audit or publication claim.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-step comparison only for two rank-one real planar gradient components of equal strength, uniform sampling, deterministic same-sample SEG with extrapolation 1/2, 0<effective step<2; finite-horizon Euclidean mean-square worst-initial-error criterion. All longer-horizon or nonlinear claims remain unproved.
title: Sharp reshuffling reversal threshold for two-component stochastic extragradient
